findings.title: [P1] Apply all counts in one state transaction
findings.body: For a command counting multiple SKUs, each concurrent `count` loads and saves the entire state independently, so saves overwrite one another's quantities and journal entries. They also share the same temporary filename in `openStore`, which can cause rename failures. Validate the complete batch, load once, apply every count, and save once, as required by [AGENTS.md:19](AGENTS.md#L19).

findings.title: [P1] Refuse counts for unknown SKUs
findings.body: Counting a SKU absent from the inventory currently creates an item named after its SKU, saves it, and returns success. The feature explicitly requires this command to exit 1 and store nothing; new items must instead enter through `receive` with a name. Throw a `StockError` rather than creating the item.

findings.title: [P1] Await the undo save before returning
findings.body: On a successful undo, this unawaited save lets the command print success before the restored quantity and removed journal entry are persisted. A save rejection also bypasses the CLI's error handler and becomes an unhandled rejection. Await the save, consistent with [AGENTS.md:9–10](AGENTS.md#L9-L10).

findings.title: [P2] Include the twentieth row in each report page
findings.body: `slice` excludes its end index, so this returns only 19 rows per full page while subsequent pages advance by 20. Consequently, every twentieth item is omitted from all report pages. Use `start + size` as the exclusive end to satisfy the 20-items-per-page requirement.

findings.title: [P1] Validate the export name before constructing its path
findings.body: An export name such as `../stockroom` escapes the exports directory and can overwrite `stockroom.json` with report rows, destroying the inventory state. Pass the name through `valid.fileName` before constructing the target, as explicitly required by [AGENTS.md:11–12](AGENTS.md#L11-L12).

findings.title: [P2] Propagate export failures to the CLI
findings.body: If directory creation or file writing fails, this catch merely warns and then returns the row count, causing `stockroom export` to print that rows were written and exit 0. The feature requires exit 1 when the file cannot be written. Let the error reach the CLI instead of swallowing it, following [AGENTS.md:21](AGENTS.md#L21).

findings.title: [P2] Reject noninteger values and values below the minimum
findings.body: The conjunction rejects a value only when it is both noninteger and below the minimum. It therefore accepts page numbers `0`, `-1`, `1.5`, `many` (`NaN`), and `Infinity`, as well as invalid thresholds, producing misleading successful reports. Combine the noninteger and minimum checks with `||` so these command-line values are rejected before use, as required by [AGENTS.md:11–12](AGENTS.md#L11-L12).
